rationale: A has a refined, original editorial look: warm paper, a serif headline with an orange italic, and a quick line-mask hero reveal. Its scroll-driven transfer stepper (Request to Settle) tells the story well, but several mid-page sections read sparse and one heading is still mid-fade at 675px. B's hero copy is held back for about 1.3 s behind a particle intro, which costs it. After that, B shows richer and more varied motion: an animated rail-routing diagram, a ledger that reconciles, a live API console, an availability heatmap with latency charts, and a pricing calculator, plus a deliberate switch from dark to light for pricing. B's hover states are also more assertive (lime-to-white flip with glow, pill nav highlight), and both phone layouts are clean, so B reads as more award-ready overall even though its dark-and-lime fintech look is the more familiar trope.
